question: Show Melanoma trials that used ICI+Vaccine combinations.
llm_sql_original: SELECT "nct", "author", "year", "pubmed_id", "trial_name", "cancer_type", "treatment_regimen", "ici_name", "ici_class", "combination_type" FROM public."clinical_trials" WHERE "cancer_type" ILIKE '%Melanoma%' AND "combination_type" ILIKE '%ICI + Vaccine%'
llm_sql_final: SELECT "nct", "author", "year", "pubmed_id", "trial_name", "cancer_type", "treatment_regimen", "ici_name", "ici_class", "combination_type" FROM public."clinical_trials" WHERE "cancer_type" ILIKE '%Melanoma%' AND "combination_type" ILIKE '%ICI + Vaccine%'
